workflowRecommendation: One implementer, tasks in order 0 → 1 → 2 → 3 → 4 (Task 3 can run any time after Task 1). Every task is fail-first: Task 1's three real-jj tests on both binaries, Task 2's five daemon tests with the fake runtime. Skip formatters, linters, and the project-wide suite mid-edit; run them once per task. Read the plan document first: dispatch://LEGION-104/artifact/plan-md (the full tasks with code, commands, and expected output).

verification-before-completion: confirm the removal runs after the StopFailed check and before tree.status = "closed" in closeTreeLocked, and that spawnRoot's wait precedes ensureTree.
